Meeting (Meeting (Page 22)) Because no one knew the inside story of the scientific examination, even if they had to think hard, they couldn't guess that Li Hong actually answered the test paper in person and was rated first. They couldn't figure this out, so naturally they couldn't figure out why Li Hong wanted to meet Li Rizhi. The coffee entered the mouth with a touch of bitterness, and unsweetened bitter coffee had always been his favorite. Feeling the coffee slipping between his lips and teeth, slowly flowing into his throat, The bitter taste with a strong fragrance is the most evocative. The bronze door is gray-brown, and there are many birds and animals carved on it. Each of them is one of the legendary spirit beasts. Apart from those, there is nothing else to see, but such a heavy door seems to be driven by an array. Children who grew up in the greenhouse do not understand human nature and the dangers of the world. They are too simple and make people worry. They grabbed the photos convulsively, tearing them apart desperately. The outsiders were attacking from the inside, and the people inside the door were defending themselves from the outside. This picture was frozen in history. In fact, Tang Feng really wanted to ask Ouyang Xue if she had ever released her passion, but if she asked, she wouldn't even be able to lift her head. What do you mean, tell me, did you deliberately want to see my joke? You are so bad." Tian Ying pinched Chen Feng hard. "Lant, pay attention, this person is extraordinary, you must not take it lightly." Chen Feng tightened his grip. The Wrath of the God of Fire did not forget to remind Lant behind him. There was actually a pond on the west side of the inner courtyard of the villa, with a few lotus flowers randomly scattered in it, adding a bit of aura, and there were actually a few colorful fish swimming leisurely in the pond.
